critical_code_review_comments: Builder.jsx is >1000 lines — should be decomposed into ChatPanel, PreviewPanel, HeaderBar, MediaUploader components for maintainability
server.py stores uploaded files (base64) and published sites in MongoDB with no expiry/cleanup — collections will grow unbounded. Consider TTL indexes or a purge endpoint.
sendMessage() merges incremental code using generatedCode from closure; consider functional setState (setGeneratedCode(prev => ...)) to avoid stale-state issues on rapid partial streams
extractCode regex is case-sensitive on ```html/```css/```javascript — add /i flag to be resilient if AI emits uppercase fence language tags
iframe sandbox uses both allow-scripts AND allow-same-origin (browser console warns this can escape sandboxing). Consider removing allow-same-origin unless the previewed code truly needs it.
Upload endpoint stores base64 in Mongo — inefficient for videos near 10MB (13MB doc). Prefer GridFS for files > a few hundred KB.
No auth/rate-limiting on /api/publish or /api/upload — anyone can flood the DB. Add basic rate limits or an owner/session token.
seed_data_creation: Some TEST_ published sites and one small PNG in db.uploaded_files (from pytest & UI upload). Not cleaned up (no delete endpoints exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (upload, publish, validate, media UI, code-in-tabs, localStorage persistence) verified end-to-end. Real AI generation still requires user-supplied API key. Video upload path uses same /api/upload endpoint as image (backend accepts video/mp4|webm|ogg|quicktime) — image path is exercised; video path is symmetric and covered by backend test coverage of content-type gating.
